title: Round 3 A: the gunship's view never cuts (the seat's floor short of the pole, glides into and out of the seat from the last picture, a re-placement under the seat eased); the four Ridgebacks on the radar as friendlies
context: Owner, 2026-10-26, on build 0df35698: '1) the Nih-Dairia fight; sometimes the view from the Gunship does a jump-cut, we need to smooth the circling motion and ensure the camera never jumps wildly from one view to another. 2) the six-legged mechs that airdrop don't show as friendlies on the radar, they should.' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-round-3-gunship-view-and-radar-design.md (decisions: measure first, fix at the source; the radar's friendlies drawn in the hull's white with a cyan ring).
outcome: Branch round-3-a from overnight-2026-10-23 (0df35698), unpushed. NOTE 2: src/fx/radar-scope.js blips the Ridgebacks after the towers and before the enemies, #f2f8ff filled at 3.5 with a 1 px #4bd7e0 ring, phosphor as the other contacts, in heart mode too; host.mechs() is mech-squad's new contacts() (each mech's live position); state().radar.mechs counts what was drawn last frame (--reinforcements: 4). NOTE 1, MEASURED with a new per-frame meter (src/fx/cam-jump.js, state().camJump; the --arena-fight window from TAKE THE GUN, CAM_PROBE=<s> for the camera alone with the gunner's drag to the seat's floor and back). The circling itself was never the cut: seated through the fight, 1,250 frames, worst 0.87 m and 0.05 degrees (the track is a parallel-transported vector with an 8 deg/s yaw cap: no lap angle, no seam; the station's endless swap changes only the clock; the harness's arenaFire never moves the aim). Three cuts were found: (1) THE SEAT'S FLOOR PAST THE POLE: GUNSHIP_PLATFORM.pitchMin -1.5708 is 3.7e-6 rad past straight down, so a drag to the floor carried the look-at across the pole and its roll flipped 180 degrees in one frame, and again on the way up (measured: 180.0 degrees at pitch -1.571); the floor is -1.5621 (89.5 degrees down). (2) INTO THE SEAT: 209.1 m and 135.2 degrees in one frame at the arena's forced hand-over (enterPilot snaps onto the first sentry's optic, mountGunship onto the gunship's, no glide); mountGunship now asks the seat glide for at least 1.8 s with its peak held to 150 m/s, and the glide leaves from the last painted picture (seatGlide.note, every frame) so a snap earlier in the same tick no longer moves its start (the first attempt without it glided from the snapped base optic: 1,899.8 m in its first frame). (3) OUT OF THE SEAT: 332.7 m and 122.9 degrees in one frame when the seat is left at her death (leavePilot cancelled the glide and snapped to the tank); leavePilot now glides out from the seat's picture. Also: boss-run's end() leaves the seat before it sends the gunship home (the home placeOver under a taken seat moved the seat's camera across the planet), the rig's placeOver under the taken seat asks a glide of at least 1.5 s (SEAT_EASE), V in the gunship's seat glides between its eye and its third view (60 m apart), and the seat's drag tolerates a refused pointer lock and a pointer it cannot capture (headless raised both as page errors). After: two --arena-fight runs, seated worst 18.52 m / 7.94 degrees and 19.22 m / 8.21 degrees, all inside the 1.8 s glide in (the larger steps on the frames headless holds near the 0.1 s dt clamp); the leave at her death 8.4 m / 7.0 degrees; CAM_PROBE with the drag on the final tree 18.29 m / 8.08 degrees, no flip (21.81 m / 9.95 degrees before the 150 m/s cap). Decisions the spec did not settle: the leave and the seat's V toggle are glided too (the owner's 'from one view to another'); the seat's entry glide is 1.8 s with a 150 m/s peak rather than the seat glide's 1.0 s; the seat's floor is 89.5 degrees, not 90.
alternatives: Easing the platform's track instead of the camera for placeOver: the track would fly 145 cells across the planet in the arena's begin; the spec asks for a slerp of the seat's pose.
Guarding the look-at's up vector near the pole instead of moving the floor: the aim's frame would still be singular at exactly -pi/2; 0.5 degrees short of it costs nothing a gunner can see.
Gliding into the seat with the seat glide's 1.0 s: its per-frame steps measured 21.8 m even at 1.8 s without the speed cap; at 1.0 s the 25 m limit would fail on the long headless frames.
evidence: Probe commit 4624fb3f (before the fix): --arena-fight seated worst 0.87 m / 0.05 degrees; outside the window 332.7 m / 122.9 degrees at the leave; CAM_PROBE=45: 209.1 m / 135.2 degrees at the seat's entry, 180 degrees twice on the drag

Fix commit 80458222: STALHEART_BROWSER_PORT=18186 npm run test:browser -- --arena-fight twice PASS (seated worst 18.52 m / 7.94 deg, 19.22 m / 8.21 deg; she died at ~45 s of game clock both times, the harness's own end); CAM_PROBE=40 PASS on the final tree (18.29 m / 8.08 deg; 21.81 m / 9.95 deg before the speed cap); --reinforcements PASS (radar friendlies drawn 4)
